title: Shenfu Injection to Improve Survival After Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation: A Meta-Analysis Protocol
author: Shuo Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.basyiefw

steps.title: Perform Literature Search
steps.instruction: Search for relevant randomized controlled trial (RCT) literature across specified databases from their inception date until November 1, 2019.

substeps.instruction: Search Medline, Embase, and PubMed using English terms: 'Shen-Fu Injection', 'Cardiopulmonary resuscitation', and 'randomized controlled trial'.
Search CNKI, Wanfang, and VIP databases using Chinese terms: '参附注射液' (Shenfu Injection), '心肺复苏' (CPR), and '随机对照' (randomized controlled).
Manually supplement the search by reviewing references and contacting authors for full texts if necessary.

steps.title: Screen and Select Literature
steps.instruction: Filter the retrieved literature based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Include studies that are clinical RCTs (any language) involving patients receiving CPR, where the experimental group received Shenfu Injection plus routine CPR and the control group received routine CPR only.
Ensure the studies report survival rate and arrhythmia incidence as outcome indicators.
Exclude duplicate literature, animal experiments, literature reviews, case reports, non-randomized clinical studies, and studies with incomplete data.

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract relevant data from the selected studies using two independent researchers.

substeps.instruction: Independently read titles and abstracts and cross-check results.
Resolve disagreements through discussion or consultation with experts.
Extract basic study information (first author, publication date, sample size), intervention protocols, outcome indicators (survival rate), and risk of bias assessment elements.

steps.title: Evaluate Study Quality
steps.instruction: Assess the risk of bias for the included literature using the Cochrane Handbook 5.1.0 tool.

substeps.instruction: Evaluate random sequence generation, allocation concealment, blinding, completeness of outcome data, selective reporting, and other biases.
Assign a rating of 'low risk', 'high risk', or 'unclear' to each element.

steps.title: Perform Meta-Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct the statistical analysis using RevMan 5.3 software.

substeps.instruction: Use the chi-square test to examine statistical heterogeneity.
Calculate Risk Ratio (RR) for count data and Standardized Mean Difference (SMD) for continuous variables, both with 95% confidence intervals (95% CI).
Apply a random-effects model initially; if heterogeneity is low (P > 0.1 and I² < 50%), switch to a fixed-effects model.
Perform sensitivity analysis by sequentially excluding individual studies and observing the difference in results.
